parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish bydło. Ultimately, from Proto-Slavic *bydlò. Cognate with Ukrainian би́дло (býdlo).
Borrowed from Polish węzeł, from Proto-Slavic *ǫzlъ. Doublet of у́зел (úzel), the inherited East Slavic form.

parole.significato: ass, arse (the buttocks of a person or animal)
parole.testo: Probably borrowed from Polish dupa (“arse”), from Proto-Slavic *dupa (“hole”).
Borrowed from Polish klęczeć, from Proto-Slavic *klęčati.
Borrowed from Polish ksiądz, from Proto-Slavic *kъnędzь. Doublet of князь (knjazʹ) and ко́нунг (kónung). Compare Ukrainian ксьо́ндз (ksʹóndz).

parole.significato: hide, coat, pelt, skin (especially when used as a material)
